title: Early Versus Routine Drain Removal After Live Liver Donor Hepatectomy
brief_summary: It's a randomized control trial to compare early drain removal versus standard drain removal after donor hepatectomy in terms of donor outcomes. We will analyse the data and elucidate the safety of early drain removal using 3x3 rule with routine drain removal.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* • Donors evaluated as per institutional protocol for donor hepatectomy and found fit

  * Those who consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients refusing to consent for inclusion in the study.
* Left lateral hepatectomy.
